title: Operational Enterprise AI
concept: Corps, a fictional rehearsal-operations system for ballet companies: a near-black hairline-grid hero that states the boundary (it drafts the cast change, the ballet master releases it) beside a sample workflow trace with an approval gate and a dancer-hours load chart, then warm-white chapters for scoped metrics and expandable workflow rows (summary, permissions, action, approval, output, audit, exception, rollback), a deterministic product console with ten run states and role-based approval, a risk-to-control table, fact/quote/interpretation case studies with filters, a buyer FAQ and a qualified review form.
notes: Onest + JetBrains Mono, one satin signal colour with a thin spectral hairline. Vanilla script only: staged trace settle, row disclosures (button + region), state machine for the demo console, case filters with consented context handoff, form validation/loading/duplicate/network-error/success. All companies, people, runs and figures are labelled sample data; no badges or compliance claims.
